blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: What do you know about first aid?
exercises.ru: Что вы знаете об ___ первой помощи?
exercises.why: «об» + prepositional. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Мы говорим об ___ (экскурсия).
exercises.prompt: We are talking about the excursion.
exercises.why: «об» + prepositional. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Academics are still debating as to the location of the Proto-Indo-European urheimat.

exercises.why: «о» + prepositional. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: О, ___ (спасибо)! Вы так заботливы.

exercises.q: The Franco-German Treaty of Friendship was signed more than forty years ago.

exercises.q: Здесь есть ряд методологических проблем, не говоря уже о ___ (неточность) некоторых результатов.

exercises.q: Wise men talk about ideas, intellectuals about facts, and the ordinary man talks about what he eats.
exercises.ru: Мудрые говорят об ___, интеллектуалы — о фактах, а простой человек о том, что ест.

exercises.q: Они продолжали нападать на нас, несмотря на однозначное согласие подписать пакт о ___ (ненападение).
exercises.prompt: They still attacked us, despite clearly agreeing to sign the non-aggression pact.
exercises.why: «о» + prepositional. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The thought of powdered sugar makes my skin crawl.

exercises.q: Если не соответствовать соглашению об ___ (имена), это может привести к ошибкам парсинга.

exercises.q: Calvin put the eighth chapter of the Epistle to the Romans as the basis of his theory of predestination.

exercises.q: Слухи об ___ (обвал) на нью-йоркском фондовом рынке вызвали волну долларовых продаж.
